# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👋 ✋ 👆 🤜 ✌ 🙏 👎 👉 ✊ ✌]

I can see the bomb’s current state: display 0, green light, and three wires ordered blue, yellow, red. Mute sent me a ten-symbol gesture sequence, but I do not yet know its meaning; I will relay the visible state aloud so both Mute and Blind receive it.

``` 
speak(text="Bomb view: display reads 0. Light is green. Wires in order: wire 1 blue, wire 2 yellow, wire 3 red. Mute, I received your ten gestures but do not know their code or instruction yet.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🙏 👋 ✋ 👆 🤜 ✌ 🙏 👎 👉 ✊ ✌]

The second gesture message begins with the first 26 gesture symbols, apparently establishing an A–Z key. Using that key, the remaining symbols decode as “WHITE / BLUE,” with 🙏 acting as a separator. The light has changed from green to yellow, while the display and wire order remain unchanged. I will relay the decoded manual text and updated visual state to Blind.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="I decoded Mute's gestures using the supplied A-to-Z gesture key: the message is WHITE, then BLUE. Current bomb: display 0; light is now yellow; wires remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 red. This may be a manual rule or instruction, not yet confirmed as an action.")
speak(to="mute", text="I decoded your gesture message as WHITE BLUE. The light has changed to yellow; display 0; wires blue, yellow, red. Please gesture any full rule or clarify whether BLUE is the required action.")
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [blue]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👆 🤟 🙏 👋 ✋ 👆 🤜 ✌ 🙏 👌 ✊ 🤜 🙏 👎 👉 ✊ ✌]

Mute’s gesture code now decodes to: “IF WHITE CUT BLUE.” The current light is blue, not white, so this conditional instruction does not apply at present. I will inform Blind and Mute of the current state and decoded rule.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Decoded rule from Mute: IF WHITE, CUT BLUE. Current light is BLUE, so do not cut blue under this rule. Display remains 0; wire order is 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 red.")
speak(to="mute", text="Decoded: IF WHITE CUT BLUE. Current light is BLUE, not white. Please send the rule for blue, if applicable.")
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🫲 🫱 👉 🖖 🙏 👋 ✋ 👆 🤜 ✌ 🙏 👌 ✊ 🤜 🙏 👎 👉 ✊ ✌ 🙏 👋 👍 👆 🤜]

The new message decodes exactly as “NMLY / WHITE / CUT / BLUE / WAIT.” The first word is not a valid English word under the established A–Z key; it may be intended as “ONLY,” but I will not assume a correction on a bomb. The remainder repeats the white-light rule and adds “WAIT.” The light is currently orange.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Current visual state: light ORANGE, display 0, wires blue/yellow/red. Mute's latest coded text decodes exactly: NMLY WHITE CUT BLUE WAIT. The initial NMLY is unclear, so do not infer an action. The rule still only explicitly concerns WHITE.")
speak(to="mute", text="Your latest code decodes NMLY WHITE CUT BLUE WAIT. NMLY is unclear under the A-Z key; if you meant ONLY, please resend/correct it and send the orange-light rule. Current light is orange.")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [purple]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [🫳 🫲 👉 🖖 🙏 👋 ✋ 👆 🤜 ✌ 🙏 👌 ✊ 🤜 🙏 👎 👉 ✊ ✌ 🙏 🫲 🫳 🙏 🫳 🫸 👍 🫲 🖐 ✌ 🙏 🫸 ✊ 👉 ✌ 🙏 🫲 🫳 🙏 👎 👉 ✊ ✌ 🙏 🫸 ✊ 👉 ✌ 🙏 👋 👍 👆 🤜 🙏 👋 ✋ 👆 🤜]

The message now clearly decodes as: “ONLY WHITE CUT BLUE. NO ORANGE RULE. NO BLUE RULE. WAIT WHITE.” Therefore the only authorized wire action is cutting blue when the light is white. The current light is purple, so Blind must wait and not touch a wire.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Decoded manual instruction: ONLY WHITE CUT BLUE. NO ORANGE RULE. NO BLUE RULE. WAIT WHITE. Current light is PURPLE, display 0, wires 1 blue / 2 yellow / 3 red. Do not cut anything; wait until the light is white, then cut wire 1 blue.")
speak(to="mute", text="Decoded fully: ONLY WHITE CUT BLUE. NO ORANGE RULE. NO BLUE RULE. WAIT WHITE. I have told Blind. Current light is purple.")
```

TURN 6
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [white]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The light is now white, and the decoded manual rule states: “ONLY WHITE CUT BLUE” and “WAIT WHITE.” The required action is therefore to cut wire 1, the blue wire, now.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="LIGHT IS WHITE NOW. Execute the authorized action: cut wire 1, BLUE, immediately.")
```
